summary: Iteration 5 regression re-test confirms BOTH iteration-4 bug fixes land cleanly. (1) WeekendCard no longer crashes on recurring events — `Repeat` is now imported at line 2 of WeekendCard.jsx and the weekend event row renders with the repeat icon, zero page errors. (2) GET /api/family/members now returns `is_owner` on every parent (backfill via mongosh applied to 2 legacy users, AND server.py lines 409-412 defensively defaults to True for any future legacy docs). All 14 backend regression tests in test_iteration4.py pass (was 13/14). Frontend smoke verified: FamilyCard renders Owner badge for both parents, WeekendCard shows the recurring daily event on Sat/Sun with the repeat indicator, no PageErrors, no functional console errors.

minor.issue: @app.on_event('shutdown') still deprecated (carried from prior iterations; not a functional issue).

issues: Radix console warning: DialogContent requires a DialogTitle + DialogDescription. Wrap the 'Shopping Mode' header with <DialogTitle> and add a <DialogDescription> (or VisuallyHidden) to satisfy a11y. Low priority, not blocking.

action_items: Optional low-priority: replace plain header div in CheckoutMode.jsx (lines ~76-90) with shadcn DialogTitle + DialogDescription/VisuallyHidden to clear the Radix a11y console warning (carried over from iter-4).
critical_code_review_comments: WeekendCard.jsx fix verified: `import { Sparkles, Repeat } from 'lucide-react'` at line 2, matches the <Repeat /> usage in DayBlock. Clean.
server.py get_family_members (lines 409-412) now guards every parent doc with `if 'is_owner' not in p: p['is_owner'] = True` — defensive layer on top of the mongosh backfill. Good belt-and-braces.
Verified via mongosh: all 3 parent users (test-user-1776655943013, user_e2e3507ff897, test-user-solo-1776808359819) now have is_owner=true persisted in DB.
PUT /api/family/info owner-gate still enforced (403 for is_owner=false, 200 for true) — test_non_owner_cannot_rename & test_owner_can_rename_family both pass.
POST /api/events/{id}/exceptions remains idempotent via $addToSet; DELETE /{date} pulls correctly; GET /api/events returns exceptions array. All 7 TestEventExceptions cases green.
